rationale: No existing spec covers the Domain -> Organization Mapping section (grep for domain-org-mapping/domainOrgMappings/domain_org_mappings in tests/ui-testing returns nothing). The closest specs (settings-form-validation.spec.js, status-pages-enterprise-gating.spec.js) establish the enterprise/cloud-gating positive-probe pattern but cover different settings features (trace ID, storage, domain management, model pricing, correlation) and the Status Pages gating. This is its own feature area with a dedicated run-context spec_path, so create a new spec. The whole feature is cloud-gated (showDomainOrgMappings = config.isCloud === 'true' && isMetaOrg), so the spec mirrors the established gating probe: on OSS it asserts the section is absent (meaningful negative gating assertion, green), on cloud it clean-skips-or-runs; the deep CRUD/validation behaviors are parked as test.fixme placeholders with file:line evidence.
